slides.title: Shared Class State
slides.prompt: 'static' members are shared across all instances of a class. Static methods can be called without an instance and cannot access 'this'.

slides.title: Static Variable Declaration
slides.prompt: Fill in keyword for class-wide shared variable.

slides.title: Static Method Access Rules
slides.prompt: Which variables can a 'static' member function access directly without an object reference?
options: Only static member variables and other static methods
slides.correctAnswer: Only static member variables and other static methods

slides.title: Scope Resolution Definition
slides.prompt: Fill in operator used to define static variable outside class body.

slides.title: Inline Static Members (C++17)
slides.prompt: What advantage does 'inline static' member declaration provide in C++17?
options: Allows static variable initialization directly inside class definition header
Converts variable to compile-time constant string
slides.correctAnswer: Allows static variable initialization directly inside class definition header

slides.title: Static Method Invocation
slides.prompt: Fill in syntax to call static method without object instance.

slides.title: This Pointer Availability
slides.prompt: Why is 'this' pointer unavailable inside static member functions?
options: Static methods are not bound to any specific class instance
Static methods are compiled as plain C functions
'this' pointer is restricted to private methods
Static methods run before main() starts
slides.correctAnswer: Static methods are not bound to any specific class instance

slides.title: Inline Static Initialization
slides.prompt: Fill in C++17 keyword to define static member inside header.

slides.title: Static Member Memory Location
slides.prompt: Where is memory allocated for a class 'static' member variable?
options: In global/static data segment, separate from object instances
Inside every instance of the class on Stack
Dynamically allocated on Heap during constructor execution
slides.correctAnswer: In global/static data segment, separate from object instances

slides.title: Constexpr Static Initialization
slides.prompt: Fill in keyword for compile-time static class constant.
